title: Evaluation of a lifted clause
statement: Let $r$ and $K$ be natural numbers, let $C$ be a conjunction of literals on $r$ sign coordinates whose literal indices are pairwise distinct, and let $x$ and $y$ be sign assignments on $r$ coordinates and $K$ auxiliary coordinates, respectively. Extend $x$ by $y$ to an assignment on $r+K$ coordinates, and lift $C$ to those coordinates by placing its indices in the first $r$ positions. The lifted clause evaluates to $-1$ on the extended assignment if and only if $C$ evaluates to $-1$ on $x$.
hypotheses_covered: The clause is a DNFTerm on $r$ coordinates, with pairwise distinct literal indices
The original assignment is a sign assignment on $r$ coordinates
The auxiliary assignment is a sign assignment on $K$ coordinates
